title: Wendell and the Escarpment
author: Gideon Lockridge
blurb: Kestrel Nakamura, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
